findings.title: Pre-existing RSpec failure: organization_ai_credits_lifecycle_spec.rb:33 expects monthly_credits_remaining 25, gets 0 (org without Stripe subscription resolves to plan_no_plan)
findings.pre_existing_evidence: Not caused by the attribution diff. (1) The b4cb4463a..a0d59115d diff contains zero changes to app/models/organization.rb, app/services/plan_feature_gate.rb, or spec/models/organization_ai_credits_lifecycle_spec.rb — `git diff b4cb4463a..a0d59115d --stat` on those three paths is empty, so the failing code and test are byte-identical on the base commit. (2) Failure is deterministic: reproduced across three runs/seeds (7682, 48910, 59957), including the single example in isolation. (3) Mechanism traced: PlanFeatureGate#initialize sets `@plan = organization.stripe_subscription_in_good_standing ? organization.plan : 'plan_no_plan'` (app/services/plan_feature_gate.rb:29). The spec's org has no Stripe subscription, so @plan = 'plan_no_plan', whose plan_rules entry has `monthly_ai_credit_allocation: 0`; `0 || MINIMUM_AI_CREDIT_ALLOCATION` returns 0 (0 is truthy in Ruby), so Organization#create_ai_credit_state_if_needed skips the update_columns guard (`allocation.positive?` false) and monthly_credits_remaining stays 0 while the spec expects 25. No exception was swallowed by the method's rescue (no `ap e` output). (4) The gating commit cd1217dd0 (introduced `stripe_subscription_in_good_standing ? organization.plan : 'plan_no_plan'`), 24852f3cc (last plan_feature_gate.rb change), and e77e5af42 (last spec-file change) are all ancestors of b4cb4463a per `git merge-base --is-ancestor`.

orchestrator_disposition.l4-001: Downgraded HIGH->MED per stock severity scale ('Pre-existing — existed before this feature was implemented'). Evidence: organization.rb, plan_feature_gate.rb, and the spec file are byte-identical on b4cb4463a; failure deterministic across seeds and in isolation; feature adds no model changes (SPEC §3). Fixing AI-credits allocation logic is outside this feature's QA scope (pipeline rules 10/23). Reported in QA-MED-FINDINGS.md for Jessica.
